name: Consistencia de Temas
description: Mide consistencia temática throughout the text.
useCase: Detección de texto IA mediante temas unnaturalmente consistentes
mechanism: Compara histograma distribucións entre content segments using cosine similarity. AI text maintains extremely consistent topic signals throughout.
source: Bakhtin et al. (2019) - Real or Fake? Learning to Discriminate Machine from Human Text
parameters: Tamaño de ventana: adaptativo, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropía, CV, correlación
strengths:
- Effective for detecting generado por IA text
- Language-agnostic estadístico approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger falsos positivos
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies a través de estilo de escrituras

references.title: Bakhtin et al. (2019) - Real or Fake? Learning to Discriminate Machine from Human Text
Zellers, R. et al. (2019). Defending Against Neural Fake News. NeurIPS.
Jawahar, G. et al. (2020). Automatic Detection of Machine Generated Text: A Critical Survey. COLING.
